prior_year_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIMM) and Mexican Earthquake
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse losses in 2017 that materially increased the 2017 underwriting year loss ratios and contributed to adverse technical results for 2017

named_events.loss_description: Excluded losses from hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexican Earthquake (HIMM) were referenced as material drivers of 2017 results
Part of the HIMM group of events referenced as impacting 2017 results

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 104.513m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a modest net favourable prior-year movement of approximately GBP 1.95m (a release, c.1.9% of opening gross reserves), driven by favourable development in the older underwriting years (notably 2015 and 2016) and recoveries. The 2017 underwriting year experienced material catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and the Mexican earthquake) which adversely impacted 2017 results, while run-off related costs and reinsurance considerations were also noted as factors affecting overall results.
raw_causal_phrases: recognition of future run-off costs and additional reinsurance costs
lower than originally anticipated gross premium exposure leading to reductions in anticipated reinsurance recoveries and expected underwriting profit
net technical result, loss of GBP 18.6m includes an additional technical provision of GBP 2.5m in respect of anticipated run-off costs for a future third-party RITC transaction
Hull, Cargo and D&O/E&O classes contributed GBP 18.3m loss on the technical result
Hull, Cargo, Property non-marine and Property marine classes contributed GBP 32.9m loss on the technical result
excluding losses from hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexican Earthquake (HIMM), these are 100% and 120% respectively

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not stated explicitly as a single gross amount in narrative; the PYD figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims estimates) - confidence moderate. No single explicit sentence describing aggregate gross prior year movement was found. Some narrative figures cite 'net' movements (after reinsurance) and year-of-account results; the triangle-based gross calculation excludes the two most recent underwriting years per guidance. There is a subsequent-event RITC noted (2016 into 2017 on 1 Jan 2019) which may affect comparability of closed-year movements disclosed elsewhere.
